content=res[\"content\"]\n    import base64\n    imgs=[]\n    cap=None\n    for c in content:\n        if c[\"type\"]==\"image\":\n            imgs.append(base64.b64decode(c[\"data\"]))\n        elif c[\"type\"]==\"text\":\n            cap=json.loads(c[\"text\"])\n    import io\n    arrs=[np.array(Image.open(io.BytesIO(b))) for b in imgs]\n    return cap,arrs\ndef backproject(cap,depth):\n    H,W=depth.shape\n    intr=cap[\"camera\"][\"intrinsics\"]\n    pos=np.array(cap[\"camera\"][\"position\"])\n    fwd=np.array(cap[\"camera\"][\"forward\"]); find boundary edge pixels between A and background, get world coords\ndef find_edges():\n    res=[]\n    views=[('iso',135,-25),('iso2',-45,-25),('top',90,-89),('front',0,0),('side',90,0),('back',180,0)]\n    for name,az,el in views:\n        cap,arrs=geom.render(['segmentation','depth'],view=name if name in ('iso','top','front','side','back') else 'iso',az=az if name not in ('iso','top','front','side','back') else None,el=el if name not in ('iso','top','front','side','back') else None,w=400,h=400)\n        seg,depth=arrs\n        pts,mask=geom.backproject(cap,depth)\n        A=(seg[:,:,0]==150)&mask\n        # edge = A pixel with a non-A 4-neighbour\n        from scipy.ndimage import binary_erosion\n        er=binary_erosion(A,np.ones((3,3)))\n        edge=A&~er\n        res.append((pts[edge],name,cap))\n    return res\nif __name__=='__main__':\n    r=find_edges()\n    allp=np.vstack([x[0] for x in r])\n    print('edge pts',allp.shape)\n    # find edges near the lower region of A's top loop where B threads: filter x in [1.0,1.4],y in[0.2,0.5],z in[0.35,0.5]\n    sel=(allp[:,0]>1.0)&(allp[:,0]<1.4)&(allp[:,1]>0.15)&(allp[:,1]<0.55)&(allp[:,2]>0.33)&(allp[:,2]<0.48)\n    print('selected',sel.sum())\n    np.save('edges.npy',allp)\n    E=allp[sel]\n    print(E.min(0),E.max(0))\nEOF\npython3 locate.py"},"output":"edge pts (6228, 3)\nselected 86\n[1.00075915 0.18673632 0.33036175] [1.07107918 0.54821244 0.41937777]\n","metadata":{"output":"edge pts (6228, 3)\nselected 86\n[1.00075915 0.18673632 0.33036175] [1.07107918 0.54821244 0.41937777]\n","exit":0,"truncated":false},"title":"cd /tmp/opencode && cat > locate.py <<'EOF'\nimport numpy as np\nfrom PIL import Image\nimport geom\n# render segmentation from 4 side-ish views; r=np.log(rad)\n    x=np.concatenate([C.ravel(),[r]])\n    S=np.arange(M)[:,None]\n    def tdist(q,C):\n        # distance from q to polyline C (piecewise linear through nodes)\n        seg0=C[:-1];seg1=C[1:]\n        v=seg1-seg0\n        qq=q[None,:,:]\n        t=np.sum((qq-seg0[:,None,:])*v[:,None,:],2)/np.maximum(np.sum(v*v,1),1e-12)[:,None]\n        t=np.clip(t,0,1)\n        proj=seg0[:,None,:]+t[...,None]*v[:,None,:]\n        dd=np.linalg.norm(qq-proj,axis=2)\n        j=np.argmin(dd,axis=0)\n        best=dd[j,np.arange(q.shape[0])]\n        return best\n    def resid(x):\n        C,r=unpack(x)\n        d=np.sqrt((P[:,None,:]-C[None,:,:])**2).sum(2).min(1)  # point to node (fast approx)\n        return np.concatenate([d-r, 0.01*(C[1:]-C[:-1]).ravel()*0])\n    # better: use point-to-polyline; do simple gradient-free via scipy\n    def resid2(x):\n        C,r=unpack(x)\n        dd=tdist(P,C)\n        # smoothness penalty on bending\n        sm=(C[2:]-2*C[1:-1]+C[:-2]).ravel()*0.3\n        return np.concatenate([dd-r,sm])\n    sol=least_squares(resid2,x,method='trf',max_nfev=600,verbose=0,x_scale='jac')\n    C,r=unpack(sol.x)\n    return C,r,sol.cost\n\nif __name__=='__main__':\n    for nm,rad in [('A',0.08),('B',0.08)]:\n        P=np.load(nm+'.npy')\n        # init from coarse angular ordering\n        cc=P.mean(0);q=P-cc;u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(q,full_matrices=False)\n        e1,e2=vt[0],vt[1]\n        xy=np.stack([P@e1,P@e2],1)\n        ang=np.arctan2(xy[:,1]-np.median(xy[:,1]),xy[:,0]-np.median(xy[:,0]))\n        order=np.argsort(ang);Ps=P[order]\n        M=40\n        groups=np.array_split(Ps,M)\n        C0=np.array([g.mean(0) for g in groups])\n        C,r,cost=fit_tube(P,rad,C0)\n        print(nm,'r',r,'cost',cost)\n        np.save(nm+'_tube.npy',np.vstack([C,[[r,0,0]]]))\n        for i in range(0,M,2): print(i,np.round(C[i],3))\nEOF\npython3 shrinkwrap.py"},"output":"(no output)\n\n<shell_metadata>\nshell tool terminated command after exceeding timeout 120000 ms. weighted procrustes\n        mu_p=(P*w[:,None]).sum(0)/w.sum();mu_q=(Q*w[:,None]).sum(0)/w.sum()\n        Pc=P-mu_p;Qc=Q-mu_q\n        H=Pc.T@(Qc*w[:,None])\n        U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)\n        D=np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])\n        Rnew=Vt.T@D@U.T\n        tnew=mu_q-Rnew@mu_p\n        Rcur,tcur=Rnew,tnew\n    P=As@Rcur.T+tcur\n    d,_=tBs.query(P)\n    return Rcur,tcur,np.mean(d**2),np.percentile(d,90),np.mean(np.abs((P-Bs[np.random.choice(len(Bs),500)]))if False else d)\nR0=R(np.load('pose_AB.npy')[3:]);t0=np.load('pose_AB.npy')[:3]\nRc,tc,c2,p90,_=icp(R0,t0)\nprint('refined mean sq',c2,'p90',p90)\nprint('R',Rc);print('t',tc)\nnp.save('pose_AB2.npy',np.vstack([tc,Rc]))\n\"","time":{"start":1794680102876,"end":1794680107713}},"id":"prt_1db451fcf001Og9FZJt5oEzZo7","sessionID":"ses_e24c05ecbffey3eGSrWDOSrWtf","messageID":"msg_1db4518bd001Tow66QGbVa97zC"}}

Let's manually find features.\n# Get the outline points of A projected on its best plane (n ~ z).\ncc=A.mean(0);q=A-cc\nu,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(q,full_matrices=False)\ne1,e2=vt[0],vt[1];n=vt[2]\nx=q@e1;y=q@e2\n# histogram find two ring centers\nfrom scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter\nH,xe,ye=np.histogram2d(x,y,bins=[80,60])\nHs=gaussian_filter(H.astype(float),2)\n# find ring centers = local minima inside the annulus -> use the \"holes\" (zero regions) surrounded by points\n# Actually find empty holes: H==0 surrounded\nfrom scipy.ndimage import binary_fill_holes,label\nmask=H>0\nfilled=binary_fill_holes(mask)\nholes=filled&~mask\nlab,nl=label(holes)\nprint('holes',nl)\nfor l in range(1,nl+1):\n    ys,xs=np.where(lab==l)\n    if len(xs)>30:\n        cx=xe[xs.mean()]+ (xe[1]-xe[0])/2;cy=ye[ys.mean()]+(ye[1]-ye[0])/2\n        # convert to 3D\n        p3=cc+cx*e1+cy*e2\n        print('hole',l,'size',len(xs),'center2d',round(cx,3),round(cy,3),'world',np.round(p3,3))\nEOF\npython3 exact.py"},"output":"holes 1\nTraceback (most recent call last):\n  File \"/tmp/opencode/exact.py\", line 29, in <module>\n    cx=xe[xs.mean()]+ (xe[1]-xe[0])/2;cy=ye[ys.mean()]+(ye[1]-ye[0])/2\n       ~~^^^^^^^^^^^\nIndexError: only integers, slices (`:`), ellipsis (`...`), numpy.newaxis (`None`) and integer or boolean arrays are valid indices\n","metadata":{"output":"holes 1\nTraceback (most recent call last):\n  File \"/tmp/opencode/exact.py\", line 29, in <module>\n    cx=xe[xs.mean()]+ (xe[1]-xe[0])/2;cy=ye[ys.mean()]+(ye[1]-ye[0])/2\n       ~~^^^^^^^^^^^\nIndexError: only integers, slices (`:`), ellipsis (`...`), numpy.newaxis (`None`) and integer or boolean arrays are valid indices\n","exit":1,"truncated":false},"title":"cd /tmp/opencode && cat > exact.py <<'EOF'\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy.spatial import cKDTree\nA=np.load('Ad.npy')\n# Find the symmetry axis of the alpha: test candidate axes directions; reflect/rotate tube should map to itself (it's a 180 rotation about the axis through centers of the two \"eyes\")\n# Instead, identify key centerline landmarks: two loop centers + bar.\n# Fit: take A's surface, compute for each point dsurf_model... we don't have model.\n# Approach: for a set of directions u and points p, rho(x)=sum over A of (x.p) distance... skip.\n# Alternative: use known alpha construction. Let's manually find features.\n# Get the outline points of A projected on its best plane (n ~ z).\ncc=A.mean(0);q=A-cc\nu,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(q,full_matrices=False)\ne1,e2=vt[0],vt[1];n=vt[2]\nx=q@e1;y=q@e2\n# histogram find two ring centers\nfrom scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter\nH,xe,ye=np.histogram2d(x,y,bins=[80,60])\nHs=gaussian_filter(H.astype(float),2)\n# find ring centers = local minima inside the annulus -> use the \"holes\" (zero regions) surrounded by points\n# Actually find empty holes: H==0 surrounded\nfrom scipy.ndimage import binary_fill_holes,label\nmask=H>0\nfilled=binary_fill_holes(mask)\nholes=filled&~mask\nlab,nl=label(holes)\nprint('holes',nl)\nfor l in range(1,nl+1):\n    ys,xs=np.where(lab==l)\n    if len(xs)>30:\n        cx=xe[xs.mean()]+ (xe[1]-xe[0])/2;cy=ye[ys.mean()]+(ye[1]-ye[0])/2\n        # convert to 3D\n        p3=cc+cx*e1+cy*e2\n        print('hole',l,'size',len(xs),'center2d',round(cx,3),round(cy,3),'world',np.round(p3,3))\nEOF\npython3 exact.py","time":{"start":1794680117354,"end":1794680118643}},"id":"prt_1db45583a001FPwjFqx3EiVyzh","sessionID":"ses_e24c05ecbffey3eGSrWDOSrWtf","messageID":"msg_1db454f7d001GHYW7C8kWoU05s"}}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794680199917,"sessionID":"ses_e24c05ecbffey3eGSrWDOSrWtf","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"bash","callID":"call_fca724ed760d4a15813fa2ab","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"command":"cd /tmp/opencode && cat > colcheck.py <<'EOF'\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy.spatial import cKDTree\nfrom scipy.ndimage import binary_dilation, binary_erosion\nA=np.load('Ad.npy')\nnp.random.seed(5)\nAs=A[np.random.choice(len(A),60000,replace=False)]\ntreeA=cKDTree(A)\ndef R_of(v):\n    th=np.linalg.norm(v)\n    if th<1e-12: return np.eye(3)\n    k=v/th;K=np.array([[0,-k[2],k[1]],[k[2],0,-k[0]],[-k[1],k[0],0]])\n    return np.eye(3)+np.sin(th)*K+(1-np.cos(th))*K@K\npose=np.load('pose_AB.npy')\nRa=R_of(pose[3:]);ta=pose[:3]\nBpos0=np.array([1.2,0.36,0.28])\nB_local=(A@Ra.T+ta)-Bpos0\nBsub=B_local[np.random.choice(len(B_local),25000,replace=False)]\ntreeB_local=cKDTree(B_local)\n# A solid voxels\nocc=np.load('occ_solid.npy');lo=np.load('occ_lo.npy');n=np.load('occ_n.npy');VOX=0.02\ndef surfdist_W(W):\n    # for each B point, distance to nearest A point (surface) - use closest-point via KD; {"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794680421549,"sessionID":"ses_e24c05ecbffey3eGSrWDOSrWtf","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"bash","callID":"call_f4daefafd5294b3b80cdb3be","state":{"status":"completed","input":{"command":"cd /tmp/opencode && cat > plan.py <<'EOF'\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy.spatial import cKDTree\nfrom scipy.ndimage import binary_closing, binary_dilation\n# load clouds\nA=np.load('Ad.npy');B=np.load('Bd.npy')\n# 1) signed distance to A surface for arbitrary world points: approximate by nearest surf point + local normal\ntreeA=cKDTree(A)\n# precompute local normals on a voxel level? do per query via kNN\ndef surf_normal(p,k=40):\n    d,idx=treeA.query(p,k=k)\n    nb=A[idx]\n    c=nb.mean(0)\n    u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(nb-c,full_matrices=False)\n    return vt[2],c\n# For collision: tube is thin; use occupancy (closed) from earlier but tuned VOX=0.02\nVOX=0.02\nlo=np.array([-0.25,-0.35,-0.35]);hi=np.array([2.65,1.85,1.05])\nn=np.ceil((hi-lo)/VOX).astype(int)\ndef occ_vox(P):\n    idx=np.floor((P-lo)/VOX).astype(int)\n    valid=(idx>=0).all(1)&(idx<n).all(1)\n    idx=np.clip(idx,0,n-1)\n    o=np.zeros(tuple(n),bool);o[idx[valid,0],idx[valid,1],idx[valid,2]]=True;return o,valid\noA,_=occ_vox(A)\noA=binary_closing(oA,iterations=1)\nnp.save('oA.npy',oA);np.save('oAlo.npy',lo);np.save('oAn.npy',n)\n# B local points = ground-truth B surface, centred at pos\nBpos0=np.array([1.2,0.36,0.28])\nB_local=B-Bpos0\nnp.save('Bloc.npy',B_local)\n# sample subsample\nnp.random.seed(1)\nBsub=B_local[np.random.choice(len(B_local),20000,replace=False)]\nnp.save('BsubGT.npy',Bsub)\ndef collide(R,pos,extra=0):\n    W=Bsub@R.T+pos\n    idx=np.floor((W-lo)/VOX).astype(int)\n    valid=(idx>=0).all(1)&(idx<n).all(1)\n    idx=np.clip(idx,0,n-1)\n    inside=oA[idx[:,0],idx[:,1],idx[:,2]]&valid\n    return inside.sum()\nif __name__=='__main__':\n    print('init coll',collide(np.eye(3),Bpos0))\nEOF\npython3 plan.py"},"output":"init coll 10\n","metadata":{"output":"init coll 10\n","exit":0,"truncated":false},"title":"cd /tmp/opencode && cat > plan.py <<'EOF'\nimport numpy as np\nfrom scipy.spatial import cKDTree\nfrom scipy.ndimage import binary_closing, binary_dilation\n# load clouds\nA=np.load('Ad.npy');B=np.load('Bd.npy')\n# 1) signed distance to A surface for arbitrary world points: approximate by nearest surf point + local normal\ntreeA=cKDTree(A)\n# precompute local normals on a voxel level? do per query via kNN\ndef surf_normal(p,k=40):\n    d,idx=treeA.query(p,k=k)\n    nb=A[idx]\n    c=nb.mean(0)\n    u,s,vt=np.linalg.svd(nb-c,full_matrices=False)\n    return vt[2],c\n# For collision: tube is thin; use occupancy (closed) from earlier but tuned VOX=0.02\nVOX=0.02\nlo=np.array([-0.25,-0.35,-0.35]);hi=np.array([2.65,1.85,1.05])\nn=np.ceil((hi-lo)/VOX).astype(int)\ndef occ_vox(P):\n    idx=np.floor((P-lo)/VOX).astype(int)\n    valid=(idx>=0).all(1)&(idx<n).all(1)\n    idx=np.clip(idx,0,n-1)\n    o=np.zeros(tuple(n),bool);o[idx[valid,0],idx[valid,1],idx[valid,2]]=True;return o,valid\noA,_=occ_vox(A)\noA=binary_closing(oA,iterations=1)\nnp.save('oA.npy',oA);np.save('oAlo.npy',lo);np.save('oAn.npy',n)\n# B local points = ground-truth B surface, centred at pos\nBpos0=np.array([1.2,0.36,0.28])\nB_local=B-Bpos0\nnp.save('Bloc.npy',B_local)\n# sample subsample\nnp.random.seed(1)\nBsub=B_local[np.random.choice(len(B_local),20000,replace=False)]\nnp.save('BsubGT.npy',Bsub)\ndef collide(R,pos,extra=0):\n    W=Bsub@R.T+pos\n    idx=np.floor((W-lo)/VOX).astype(int)\n    valid=(idx>=0).all(1)&(idx<n).all(1)\n    idx=np.clip(idx,0,n-1)\n    inside=oA[idx[:,0],idx[:,1],idx[:,2]]&valid\n    return inside.sum()\nif __name__=='__main__':\n    print('init coll',collide(np.eye(3),Bpos0))\nEOF\npython3 plan.py","time":{"start":1794680420868,"end":1794680421546}},"id":"prt_1db49f9ff0014Ge3iVpDICFLKv","sessionID":"ses_e24c05ecbffey3eGSrWDOSrWtf","messageID":"msg_1db49f261001FTvlSGkquYHLlG"}}

Use 3-vector rot (axis-angle) small\n# We'll parametrize rotation as a rotation vector (Rodrigues) with magnitude up to pi.\ndef R_of(v):\n    th=np.linalg.norm(v)\n    if th<1e-12: return np.eye(3)\n    k=v/th;K=np.array([[0,-k[2],k[1]],[k[2],0,-k[0]],[-k[1],k[0],0]])\n    return np.eye(3)+np.sin(th)*K+(1-np.cos(th))*K@K\nstart=np.array([1.2,0.36,0.28,0,0,0])  # pos + rotvec\ndef is_free(s,tol=0):\n    R=R_of(s[3:]);return plan.collide(R,s[:3])<=tol\n# discretization\nDP=0.04; DA=0.05\ndef key(s): return tuple(np.round(s/[DP,DP,DP,DA,DA,DA]).astype(int))\n# A* heuristic: distance to any free-space (we want success = can slide to infinity => just need a pose with large clearance along some ray).
